description: Piko Ceno 3.11.0: Piko 3.11.0 with the Ceno settings page. The Ceno category holds real switches and options for Cenotaph features: chat wallpaper (scale, dim, blur), hide typing status, and hide ads. Built for Instagram 452.1.0.53.64 (385811006).

patches.name: Ceno - Settings app
patches.description: Adds the Ceno launcher icon. It lists only the features this bundle actually hooks.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Chat wallpaper hook
patches.description: Feeds Cenotaph's wallpaper into Instagram's own thread background image, where the app sets it.

patches.name: Cenotaph - DM streak (client only)
patches.description: Shows a client-side day streak on DM threads. Nothing is sent to anyone.

options.description: Count days you open a DM thread on this device. Nothing is sent.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Disable ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored ad pods in the feed.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Disable typing status
patches.description: Stops Cenotaph from telling a chat that you are typing.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Runtime (required)
patches.description: Lifecycle hook into Instagram's Application. Every other Cenotaph patch registers here; leave it enabled.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Thread anchor (required)
patches.description: Hooks the DM thread screen and hands its root view to the other Cenotaph patches. Leave it enabled.

release_notes:
Piko 3.11.0 with the Ceno category.

- Ceno row in Piko's settings with a page of Cenotaph switches and list controls: chat wallpaper, scale, dim, blur, hide typing status, hide ads.
- Values are stored in the cenotaph prefs file that the Cenotaph hooks read.

Install: uninstall the official Instagram first, then patch Instagram 452.1.0.53.64 with this bundle.
Not yet tested on a device.
repoDescription: Cenotaph — standalone Morphe patches for Instagram: chat wallpaper, chat tint, colour map, bubble corners, local font, DM streaks and a theme picker. Built for Instagram 447.0.0.55.81.
